definitions.explanation: Cosmetic treatment of the toenails, including filing, polishing, and decorating. In Japanese usage, often refers specifically to toenail polish or nail art applied to the toes, rather than the full foot-care treatment.

examples.japanese: ペディキュア⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}った→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。
⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦サンダル→サンダル：01365_sandaru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履|は}く→履く：00700_haku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、ペディキュア⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I get a pedicure in summer since I wear sandals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦ネイル→ネイル：25891_neiru⟧⟦サロン→サロン：10952_saron⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦マニキュア→マニキュア：19400_manikyua⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ペディキュア⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: Before the wedding, I had both a manicure and pedicure done at the nail salon.

notes:
From English/French "pedicure." In Japanese, ペディキュア can refer to either the nail polish itself (the product applied to toenails) or the service of having one's toenails done at a salon.

In casual Japanese, ペディ is sometimes used as a shortened form.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ペディキュア⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧: to apply toenail polish
- ペディキュア⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do a pedicure / get a pedicure
- ペディキュア⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧: to remove toenail polish
- フット⟦ネイル→ネイル：25891_neiru⟧: foot nail (art) — synonym in nail salon terminology

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦マニキュア→マニキュア：19400_manikyua⟧: manicure — nail treatment for the hands
- ⟦ネイル→ネイル：25891_neiru⟧⟦アート→アート：10713_aato⟧: nail art — decorative designs on nails
- ジェル⟦ネイル→ネイル：25891_neiru⟧: gel nail — long-lasting gel-based nail coating
- フットケア: foot care — broader term including skin and nail treatment
